description: Served with the 167th Fighter-Interceptor Squadron West Virginia Air National Guard on Cold War air defence alert for Washington DC; never saw combat; acquired by Don Moyer Sr in 1961 and after decades in storage restored and moved to the airport between 1999 and 2001; 52-2044 lies inside the F-86H block 52-1975 to 52-2124; serial and history from the on-site interpretive marker
